statement:
by
  classical
  let S := fun {r s : ℕ} (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r) (β : DirichletCharacter ℂ s) (m : ℕ) =>
    ∑' q : ℕ, if hq : q ≠ 0 then
      let _ : NeZero q := ⟨hq⟩
      if h : r ∣ q ∧ s ∣ q then
        let A := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.1 α
        let B := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.2 β
        gaussSum A ZMod.stdAddChar * gaussSum B ZMod.stdAddChar *
          gaussSum (A*B)⁻¹ (ZMod.stdAddChar.mulShift (-(m:ZMod q))) / (q.totient:ℂ)^2
      else 0
    else 0
  let O := S (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
  let B := Σ s : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ s
  let primitive := fun b : B => b.1 ≠ 0 ∧ b.2.IsPrimitive
  let f := fun p : ℕ => if p.Prime ∧ 3 ≤ p then 1 + 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 2)^2 else 1
  exact ∃ C : ℝ, HasProd f C ∧
    (∀ K : ℝ, (∀ (r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r), α.IsPrimitive →
      ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → Even m → ∀ F : Finset B, (∀ b ∈ F, primitive b) →
      (∑ b ∈ F, ‖S α b.2 m‖^3) ≤ K * ‖O m‖^3) ↔ C ≤ K) ∧
    (∀ (r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r), α.IsPrimitive →
      ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → Even m → ∀ F : Finset B, (∀ b ∈ F, primitive b) →
      (F.filter (fun b => ‖O m‖ < Real.sqrt 2 * ‖S α b.2 m‖)).card ≤ 6)

plain_statement.zh: 求所有导子上的最佳统一三次矩常数，并把超过普通值 1/√2 的搭档数降至至多六个。
plain_statement.en: Determine the optimal all-conductor cubic moment and bound the number of partners above the 1/√2 threshold by six.

brief.zh: 对每个素数幂使用 #4245 的局部预算，保留素数 Euler 乘积；在 m=2、首特征平凡的奇素数连乘水平由已发布的 sharp-cubic-level 寻找逼近上确界的有限族。对 ≤31 的素数精确相乘，余积用 30/29 控制。六是上界，不要求取到。
brief.en: Retain the prime product of the local budgets in #4245. Approximate the supremum by the principal row at m=2 on odd primorial levels. Bound the tail after 31 by 30/29 and apply the cubic bound to the strict threshold. Six need not be attained.
